question: Who among the following has been elected as the 36th President of BCCI?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Roger Binny**__

 
• **Roger Binny** has been elected as the 36th President of the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI).
 
• He succeeded **Sourav Ganguly**, who served as the 35th President of BCCI.
 
• Roger Binny is a former Indian cricketer and was part of the Indian team that won the 1983 Cricket World Cup.
 
• His election marks a significant change in the leadership of the BCCI, which is the governing body for cricket in India.

 
• The **Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI)** is the national governing body for cricket in India.
 
• It was formed in December 1928 and is headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra.
 
• The BCCI is responsible for organizing domestic and international cricket matches in India, as well as the Indian Premier League (IPL).
 
• It is one of the richest and most powerful cricket boards in the world.
